lines.inspiration.struck: The Lord, or somebody, has a job for you. You accept. You'd accept anything right now, but you accept this one in particular.
lines.inspiration.expired: You let it go. That's alright. You forgive yourself. You forgive everyone in this room, out loud, one at a time.
lines.scavenge.found: Somebody left behind {item}. You take it into your care. Somebody has to.
lines.scavenge.nothing: Nothing. The Lord provides, but not on a schedule.
lines.item.used: You finish the {item} and look around for someone to share the next one with. Or to forgive.
lines.making.abandoned.lost: You let it go unfinished. Some things the Lord takes back early. You pat it, like a shoulder.
lines.piece.artist.inspired: Done: {work}. You'd like everyone here to come and look at it, and then you'd like to buy every one of them a drink.
lines.piece.artist.rough: Done: {work}. It's not perfect. Nothing is, son. You forgive it, and you mean it.
lines.game.karaoke.pushed: You testify. You find the biggest man in the room and you sing it directly to him.
lines.location.return: Back at {place}, my child. Everybody comes back. That's the whole trouble with everybody.
